# Beast Mastery Hunter — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 34/17/0 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 84 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (2 members), level 48 (2 members), level 60 (2 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/beast-mastery/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 122% / 75% of the human spec median (328 vs 268.9 own / 435.5 pet-incl boss DPS over 22 boss fights); pet damage invisible, so true ≥122% [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [beast-mastery.md](./beast-mastery.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **9 — pet attack** (`HB00d-pet-attack`) — level 10+ · intent `filler`
  - **When:** in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; the pet is not on the target; the target is hostile; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the target is attacking the resident or the lowest party health below 0%).
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target).
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/beast-mastery/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `core PetAI.cpp L465-L500`; `core Unit.cpp L9295-L9345`; `doc module/bots/src/Tick.cpp`; +1 more].
- **28 — Kill Command** (`HB05-kill-command`) — level 43+ · intent `filler` · spell 41827
  - **When:** in combat; the resident has the aura state 6 state; Kill Command is off cooldown; the pet exists; the pet is alive.
  - **Why:** Beast Mastery talent (391) at 40, DependsOn Spirit Bond 2/2; free, 8 s recoveryTime, 45 yd, and casterAuraState 6, which is AURA_STATE_CRIT -- the state the core sets on a caster that has recently critically hit.
  - Sources: [leveling.md § Levels 40–49 (L205)](leveling.md#levels-40-49); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/beast-mastery/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:391`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L24085`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; +5 more].

  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-145 (p5-econ's census, 2026-10-08: every resident 20+ holds usable food, but a third hold none of the items the eat and drink rungs name, so no rung was ever true for them; the worst rogue began 9 of 23 fatal fights under 20…
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/beast-mastery/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_item_template.sql L168`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L372`; `open question OQ-041`; +2 more].
- **130 — Approach the target** (`HB13-approach`) — level 1+ · intent `move`
  - **When:** has a target; the target is farther than 35 yd.
  - **Why:** A ranged spec approaches only to reach its range; the runtime decides whether the move is possible (OQ-1401).
- **140 — Loot** (`HB14-loot`) — level 1+ · intent `loot`
  - **When:** not in combat.
- **150 — Vendor** (`HB15-vendor`) — level 1+ · intent `vendor`
  - **When:** not in combat.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **HB00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 233); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **HB00u-tel-abim-surprise — Use Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise (item 60976, required level 55), the ranged AP food (+45 RAP): "Firewater gives melee AP only; Danonzo's is the ranged AP food" (marksmanship.md L240); out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 57042 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HB00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), mana regeneration, the page's min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 24363 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HB00u-greater-arcane-elixir — Use Greater Arcane Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Greater Arcane Elixir (item 13454, required level 47), spell damage, a min-max pick (the page rates spell power low, marksmanship.md L102, but lists it L234); out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 17539 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HB00u-nature-power — Use Elixir of Greater Nature Power:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Elixir of Greater Nature Power (item 50237, required level 48), nature spell damage, a min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 45988 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HB00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46), spell power and spell crit, a min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 45427 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HB00u-potion-of-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Potion of Quickness (item 61181, required level 50, aura 45425: haste, 10 s, 2 min cooldown): "Potion of Quickness or Juju Flurry on pull or after Rapid Fire" (marksmanship.md L236). On a boss with the buff down, like the Juju Flurry rules (HO-253); Juju Flurry is not duplicated here.
- **HB00u-mana-oil-main — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Brilliant Mana Oil (item 20748, required level 45, enchant 25123: 12 mana per 5 s, 30 minutes) on the mainhand weapon: "Double Brilliant Mana Oil on two one-handers ... lets you skip Viper" (marksmanship.md L162; the Beast Mastery page takes the MM kit, L166).
- **HB00u-mana-oil-off — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Brilliant Mana Oil (item 20748, required level 45, enchant 25123: 12 mana per 5 s, 30 minutes) on the offhand weapon: "Double Brilliant Mana Oil on two one-handers ... lets you skip Viper" (marksmanship.md L162; the Beast Mastery page takes the MM kit, L166).
- **HB00b-call-pet — Call Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6082 'Taming the Beast', kit.yaml), costs nothing (spell_template manaCost 0) and needs no target: effectImplicitTargetA1 32, targets 0, so the loop's own targetGuid (healTarget or hostile) is irrelevant, the same way a self-only buff resolves regardless of what RotationAction passes (Loop.cpp's own comment, next to Fade and Inner Fire). Priority 7, straight after HB00a-eat (6) and before every buff (HB01a at 15) and before the opener (HB01 at 10): THE PET WAS NEVER MISSING FROM THE DATABASE, ONLY FROM THE WORLD -- this spec is the one that names the pet its whole point, and it had no rule to bring one into being.
- **HB00c-revive-pet — Revive Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6081 'Training the Beast', kit.yaml, same acquisition tier as Call Pet), a 10 s cast (castingTimeIndex 7, SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 10000) and NOT free: manaCost 0 but manaCostPercentage 100, which Spell::CalculatePowerCost prices at 100 per cent of BASE mana for the caster's level (player_classlevelstats: hunter level 23 is 541) -- the whole bar, not a share of it. `mana_pct >= 100` was the first draft and was DISCARDED: it is only ever true at a single mana level, which is the same failure class this workstream's reactive rules already document elsewhere (a guard that is merely safe but rarely true just re-fires the refusal every tick), and decision 42 asks for a pet that WORKS, not one that is technically affordable and never revived.
- **HB00d-pet-attack — pet attack:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target). A defensive player pet ignores its owner's attack while it is out of combat (PetAI::OwnerAttacked returns when the pet is not in combat and its owner is a player), so with no rule that sends it in it fought only what hit it or its owner: on the tank's target on 84 of 169 in-combat ticks in round 79.
- **HB01s-serpent-sting-boss — Serpent Sting:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d); p1-loop v27 target.boss): "Skip on normal mobs ... Use Serpent Sting only as a boss opener in dungeons" (hunter/leveling.md L127, L165, L286): once the tank holds the boss, once per boss (aura_target, the first rank of the chain).
- **HB06f-concussive-shot-runner — Concussive Shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Concussive Shot (50 per cent slow, 4 s) on a runner in shot range.
- **HB07f-wing-clip-runner — Wing Clip:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Wing Clip on a runner still in melee reach.
- **HB01s2-scorpid-sting-elite — Scorpid Sting:** amp-6 rotation patch (owner order 2026-10-18, beyond HO-TKB-PLAY-212): the guide's Scorpid Sting rule is "Scorpid Sting only to help the pet tank an elite. It shares the one-Sting-per-hunter limit with Serpent Sting, so it yields to a Serpent already on the target (`not aura_target(1978)`) and it is NOT used on a boss, which keeps the Serpent opener of HB01s-serpent-sting-boss; it is for the elite the pet (or a levelling hunter) is tanking.
- **HB01a-aspect-of-the-viper — Aspect of the Viper:** At the pin it is a level-56 trainer aspect costing nothing to cast whose single effect is aura 21 (SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_MANA), a periodic mana return, and it replaces Aspect of the Hawk because a hunter holds one aspect at a time. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HB02-aspect-of-the-hawk — Aspect of the Hawk:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **HB02b-trueshot-aura — Trueshot Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-280 (leveller pass): Trueshot Aura is trained at 40 as a baseline single-rank aura (hunter/leveling.md L198, L287); the marksmanship file already holds it, the beast-mastery file never cast it, so a BM hunter of 40-60 gave its party no ranged attack power. Free (manaCost 0), permanent, and an area party aura that also sits on the hunter (see HM02-trueshot-aura), so aura_self sees it; one cast a session.
- **HB02a-aspect-of-the-monkey — Aspect of the Monkey:** Aspect of the Hawk (level 10, priority above this rule) replaces it: `not aura_self(13165)` keeps the two from flapping and the Hawk rule wins the tick whenever it can be cast.
- **HB05-kill-command — Kill Command:** Beast Mastery talent (391) at 40, DependsOn Spirit Bond 2/2; free, 8 s recoveryTime, 45 yd, and casterAuraState 6, which is AURA_STATE_CRIT -- the state the core sets on a caster that has recently critically hit. So this is a reactive: it is the only rule in any hunter file the vocabulary can gate exactly, and it is the only rule in this file that is about the pet at all, since what it does is order the pet to strike.
- **HB03-bestial-wrath — Bestial Wrath:** Beast Mastery talent (386); free, 90 s recoveryTime, 18 s. `target.hostile` is dropped (in_combat carries the intent) and the pet terms the spell needs (its target is the caster's pet, effectImplicitTargetA1 5) are added.
- **HB03r-rapid-fire — Rapid Fire:** In a party only once the tank has opened threat on the target, as the pet''s attack waits.
- **HB04-intimidation — Intimidation:** Beast Mastery talent (387); free, 60 s recoveryTime, and it stuns what the pet is on. Gated on target.attacking_self, because the moment worth a minute of cooldown is the one where the mob has left the pet and come for the hunter.
- **HB04f-feign-death — Feign Death:** HO-TKB-PLAY-147 (p4-pioneer decision 194, track 4 steps up to Gnomeregan at 34): "If the mob turns on you while the pet is alive: Feign Death, and the mob goes back to the pet", "If a mob sticks to you: Concussive Shot and kite, or Feign Death" (hunter/leveling.md L181, L187; "Before 30 you have no Feign Death", L149). HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **HB05s-scare-beast-second — Scare Beast:** The guide, hunter/leveling.md L148: "On beasts, Scare Beast the second mob (1.5 s cast)"; the pet and the shots take the first. Alone only (in a party a feared mob runs into the group), the second attacker is a beast (`creature_type(1)`), 35 mana at level 14, 50 at rank 2 (level 30).
- **HB06-concussive-shot — Concussive Shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-280 (leveller pass): with a living pet the slow is for the mob that has turned on the hunter, not for a mob the pet is holding: "If the mob turns on you: Concussive Shot, then back off and let Growl take it back" (hunter/leveling.md L143), "If a mob sticks to you: Concussive Shot and kite" (L187), "Losing aggro, or the pet dies: Feign Death, or Concussive Shot and kite" (L300). Below 10 there is no pet and the guide opens with it as the pull (L125), and without a living pet it is the old rule; the runner rule HB06f is unchanged.
- **HB08b-mend-pet — Mend Pet:** Trainer spell at 12 (kit.yaml, trainer_learn_spell 1117), 50 mana at the pin (spell_template manaCost 50) and, contrary to how it reads, NOT instant: attributesEx 4 is SPELL_ATTR_EX_CHANNELED_1 and durationIndex 28 is 5000 ms -- 'heals your pet X health every second while you focus, lasts 5s' -- the same shape as the warlock's Health Funnel (755), which decision 44 keeps strictly out of combat. CHECKED BEFORE SHIPPING IT IN COMBAT: channelInterruptFlags is 31756 (0x7C0C) at the pin, which decodes to CHANNEL_FLAG_INTERRUPT (0x0004), CHANNEL_FLAG_MOVEMENT (0x0008) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DELAY (0x4000) -- CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE (0x0002) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE2 (0x0080) are both ABSENT, so taking a hit does not break this channel, which closes the specific re-fire risk (a half-broken channel next to an active fight) that would otherwise be the strongest argument against it.
- **HB09-multi-shot — Multi-Shot:** A mob on the pet is not counted (risk noted in HUN-01). Kestrel (marksmanship; no beast-mastery hunter is streamed), round 34: 36 pushes in combat (0.99 a minute), 7 with three or more engaged within 15 yd (0.19 a minute); round 33 29 and 10 (0.31) (r35-ladder-check.txt).
- **HB09b-volley — Volley:** HO-TKB-PLAY-280 (leveller pass): "Volley only on 3+ mobs that are all on the pet (it costs 210 mana)" (hunter/leveling.md L212, level 40 from L198); at 60 "3+ targets: open with Volley" (beast-mastery.md L35, L126). Three or more engaged enemies within 30 yd, and the target is NOT on the hunter, so the pack is on the tank or the pet.
- **HB10h-arcane-shot-hawk-eye — Arcane Shot:** The level-60 build takes Hawk Eye 2/2 (spell 19499: 'increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards', EffectBasePoints 5 on a one-sided die; Marksmanship 17 points of the 34/0/17 build, beast-mastery.md L66) and the marksmanship guide gives 'safe pulls from 41 yards' (marksmanship.md L7). HO-TKB-PLAY-320 (amp-2 KB comparison): Steady Shot is the filler after each Auto Shot and Arcane Shot comes after it: "Steady Shot after each Auto Shot, without clipping" (hunter/beast-mastery.md L110), "Arcane Shot after Steady when it fits" (L111), "Auto, Steady, Arcane, Auto" (L102); levelling L162-L163 (Steady after each Auto, Arcane the cheap trigger and the shot while moving).
- **HB10-arcane-shot — Arcane Shot:** Steady Shot has no cooldown and is true whenever the hunter stands still, so a rule below it never ran while the hunter stood; the guide's loop is 'Auto, Steady, Arcane (or Multi), Auto' with 'Arcane after Steady when it fits' (beast-mastery.md L102, L108-L109): Arcane's own 6 s cooldown and the 40 per cent mana floor already say when it fits, so listing it first lets Steady fill the rest. HO-TKB-PLAY-320 (amp-2 KB comparison): Steady Shot is the filler after each Auto Shot and Arcane Shot comes after it: "Steady Shot after each Auto Shot, without clipping" (hunter/beast-mastery.md L110), "Arcane Shot after Steady when it fits" (L111), "Auto, Steady, Arcane, Auto" (L102); levelling L162-L163 (Steady after each Auto, Arcane the cheap trigger and the shot while moving).
- **HB09h-steady-shot-hawk-eye — Steady Shot:** The level-60 build takes Hawk Eye 2/2 (spell 19499: 'increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards', EffectBasePoints 5 on a one-sided die; Marksmanship 17 points of the 34/0/17 build, beast-mastery.md L66) and the marksmanship guide gives 'safe pulls from 41 yards' (marksmanship.md L7).
- **HB09a-steady-shot — Steady Shot:** Steady Shot was in the Marksmanship rotation and not this one, and the archive puts it at priority 3 of the Beast Mastery list - "Steady Shot after each Auto Shot, never clipping the auto", because it is what crit-fishes for Kill Command, which this spec's capstone requires (HB05 is gated on aura_state 6, the crit state).
- **HB11-raptor-strike — Raptor Strike:** It is in a Beast Mastery file for one reason: a hunter whose target has closed still has globals to spend.
- **HB11b-mongoose-bite — Mongoose Bite:** 30 mana, 5 s category cooldown, melee, and at the pin no casterAuraState (tkbplay-280.result.txt), so it is on cooldown and not on a dodge.
- **HB12h-auto-shot-hawk-eye — Auto Shot:** The level-60 build takes Hawk Eye 2/2 (spell 19499: 'increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards', EffectBasePoints 5 on a one-sided die; Marksmanship 17 points of the 34/0/17 build, beast-mastery.md L66) and the marksmanship guide gives 'safe pulls from 41 yards' (marksmanship.md L7).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **HB00u-mana-oil-main:** Brilliant Wizard Oil (L234) is NOT built: it would take the same two slots and replace this oil (open question 1).
- **HB00u-mana-oil-off:** Brilliant Wizard Oil (L234) is NOT built: it would take the same two slots and replace this oil (open question 1).
- **HB02c-aspect-of-the-cheetah:** OUR OWN NUMBER, flagged as open question 4: `mana_pct >= 70`, because the swap costs 40 plus 20 mana a mob and the guide's own rule for this bar is that mana is the limit (L307); without a floor the rule would spend a quarter of a level-20 bar per kill. Not expressible: 'between mobs' as a travel state; `not in_combat and not target.hostile` is the closest the vocabulary has, and a dead mob that stays selected keeps the rule off until the target clears.
- **HB09b-volley:** WHAT IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE, open question 2: a mob on the pet is not an engaged enemy (EngagedDistances counts hostiles whose victim is a party member; solo, victim == the player), so a solo hunter whose pet holds three mobs never counts them; the rule works in a party, where the tank's mobs are engaged.
- **HB10h-arcane-shot-hawk-eye:** 2500 ms is our own number (Steady is a 1 s cast plus 0.5 s: marksmanship.md L112), open question 1.
- **HB10-arcane-shot:** 2500 ms is our own number (Steady is a 1 s cast plus 0.5 s: marksmanship.md L112), open question 1.
- **HB12-auto-shot:** The 2,923 autorepeat_active refusals (the push while it is already repeating) cannot be expressed here: no predicate says that Auto Shot is running, so that refusal is the runtime's (p3-runtime, p1-loop).
